title: Attach for access to RLOS not accepted by the network

entities.name: Attach for access to RLOS
entities.description: UE-initiated attach procedure specifically for accessing RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services).

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT message
entities.description: Network-to-UE message rejecting an attach request.

entities.name: EMM cause #35
entities.description: EMM cause value indicating 'Requested service option not authorized in this PLMN'.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: UE state entered when attach is rejected with EMM cause #35, triggering PLMN selection.

entities.name: Access to RLOS still needed
entities.description: Condition where UE continues to require RLOS access, affecting subsequent actions.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that, if not running, allows PLMN selection after attach rejection in the same PLMN.

entities.name: Skip GERAN/UTRAN selection and E-UTRA disable
entities.description: UE behavior to skip actions involving GERAN/UTRAN selection or disabling E-UTRA capability while RLOS access is needed.

relations.description: ATTACH REJECT message includes EMM cause #35 when RLOS attach is not accepted.
Attach procedure for RLOS may result in ATTACH REJECT message from network.
Receiving EMM cause #35 in ATTACH REJECT causes UE to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state.
Condition 'access to RLOS still needed' guards UE behavior to skip GERAN/UTRAN selection and E-UTRA disable actions.
Timer T3346 not running is a condition for PLMN selection when RLOS access is still needed in the same PLMN.
